title: Study on the Quality of Life and Pathological State in Patients Who Underwent Radical Cystectomy
official: Bladder Archive: Observational Study on the Quality of Life and Pathological State in Patients Who Underwent Radical Cystectomy
summary: Observational study on the quality of life and pathological state of patients underwent radical cystectomy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* subjects underwent radical cystectomy
* \> 18 years old
* Ability to read and sign the informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 years
* Inability to read and sign the informed consent
